messages:
sam: deploy-bot flagged canary p95 spike (+220ms) on chatstream. traffic at 10%. deploybot recommends autosuppress — should we let it or do a manual hold? @tina @ravi
deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary p95 latency 2.10s (+220ms). Suggested action: autosuppress. Triggered at 6473829098.
tina: on it, starting traces now. which model variant and region?
ravi: looks like eu-west-1, routes: embeddings and chatstream. I'll collect traces.
lina: personal preference: manual hold. autosuppress can mask regressions caused by kernel changes. +1 to manual hold and quick probe.
sam: I agree with lina. plan: hold canary traffic, run a targeted probe comparing v2.4.3 (current) vs v2.4.2 (previous). if probe confirms regression, rollback to 2.4.2 and notify customers. micah, can you take the hold?
micah: I have authority. running `deployctl hold --target canary --by micah` now.
ops-bot: Action: canary traffic hold executed by micah at 6473829120.
tina: tailing traces — I see increased time in kernel selection path, ~500/1000 requests with longer compile/kerneltime. no obvious 5xxs.
ravi: correlating with new kernel option flip in 2.4.3. candidate quick mitigation: `--no-adaptive-kernel` toggle on serving nodes. can we probe that?
sam: decision: hold + probe. if probe returns baseline p95 -> unhold. if probe shows regression -> rollback to 2.4.2 and stage rollout. lina please prep a short customer blurb and internal release note.
lina: drafting now — will post to #customers-ready and email sales.
micah: running probe now: small burst to compare v2.4.3 vs v2.4.2.
micah: probe results: v2.4.3 p95 2.05s, v2.4.2 p95 1.82s. delta ~230ms > our threshold (150ms).
sam: confirmed. manual rollback recommended. micah, please execute `deployctl rollback --target canary --to 2.4.2` and keep traffic held during the operation. notify when done.
micah: starting rollback: `deployctl rollback --target canary --to 2.4.2` (job queued) 6473829250
deploy-bot: Rollback job queued for canary -> target 2.4.2. ETA ~90s.
ops-bot: Rollback completed on canary at 6473829310. Post-rollback p95: 1.79s. No elevated 5xxs.
tina: observing metrics — p95 trending back to baseline, traces show kernel path stable. good.
sam: recommend unhold and monitor 15 minutes. micah please unhold when ready.
micah: unhold executed: `deployctl unhold --target canary` at 6473829380
deploy-bot: Canary traffic resumed. Monitoring window: 15m.
lina: release note sent to #customers-ready and brief to sales. I'll add the rollback reason and mitigation note.
sam: thanks team — good quick coordination. closing thread. :thumbsup:
